title: Co-Marketing and Promotion Fund Claims
summary: Check dealer and retailer claims on co-marketing, promotion and advertising funds against the approved plan, budgets and proof of activity before finance releases money.

seo.title: Co-Marketing Fund Claims Verification | VipraTech
seo.description: Verify co-marketing, MDF and promotion fund claims against approved plans, budgets, invoices and proof of activity before finance releases payments.

problem.intro: Brands share the cost of local marketing with dealers and large retailers: newspaper ads, in-store events, hoardings, festive promotions and digital campaigns. Partners claim their share with vendor invoices and proof of activity. Checking each claim against the approved plan and budget is slow, so claims either wait for months or are paid without much checking.

pain_points.title: Activity that was never approved
pain_points.detail: Claims arrive for activities, amounts or periods outside the plan that was signed off.

pain_points.title: Invoices that do not prove the activity
pain_points.detail: Vendor invoices, photos and media proofs are missing, generic or reused from earlier claims.

pain_points.title: Budgets overrun
pain_points.detail: Without a running balance per partner, claims exceed the fund allocated for the period.

pain_points.title: Slow settlement sours partners
pain_points.detail: Partners wait months for reimbursement and lose interest in running the next activity.

solution.overview: VipraTech keeps a register of approved activities, budgets and sharing ratios for each partner and period. Each claim is read with its vendor invoices and proofs, matched to an approved activity, and checked for amount, period, sharing ratio and remaining budget. Invoices and photos are checked for completeness and for reuse across claims. Lines that pass go to the payout sheet, and the rest go to channel marketing or finance with the reason.
capabilities: Register of approved activities, budgets and sharing ratios by partner
Reads vendor invoices and proofs in PDF, image or spreadsheet form
Matches each claim to an approved activity and checks amount and period
Tracks the remaining budget for each partner and period
Flags invoices and photos reused across claims
Payout sheet and fund utilisation report

workflow.title: Register approvals
workflow.detail: Approved activities, budgets and sharing ratios are recorded for each partner and period.

workflow.title: Receive claims
workflow.detail: Partners submit claims with vendor invoices and proof of activity.

workflow.title: Match and check
workflow.detail: Each claim is matched to an approved activity and checked for amount, period, ratio and budget.

workflow.title: Check proofs
workflow.detail: Invoices and photos are checked for completeness and reuse.

workflow.title: Review
workflow.detail: Channel marketing or finance reviews flagged claims with the reason.

workflow.title: Approve and pay
workflow.detail: Finance approves the payout sheet, and fund use is reported by partner.

inputs: Approved marketing plans, budgets and sharing ratios
Photos, media proofs and event reports
outputs: Flags for unapproved, over-budget or poorly proven claims
Fund utilisation by partner and period
human_in_the_loop: Channel marketing decides on claims outside the approved plan, and finance approves every payout. Doubtful proofs are flagged for a person, never rejected automatically.
integrations: ERP such as SAP or Tally for payouts or credit notes
Marketing approval sheets or workflow tool
guardrails: No payout without a matched approved activity
Budget balance checked before every approval
Reused invoices and photos held for review
Every payout linked to its proofs
compliance_notes: Claims backed by vendor invoices support the tax treatment your finance team applies; the system keeps every invoice with its payout.

pilot.scope: One quarter of co-marketing claims for one region or one partner group.
deliverables: Approved activity register for the pilot
Payout sheet in your finance format

what_we_measure.how: Share of claims matched to an approved activity.
Unapproved, over-budget or unproven claims confirmed by finance.
Time from claim to payout, compared with today.

faqs.q: Our approvals happen over email. Can that work?
faqs.a: Yes. Approvals can be captured from a sheet or forwarded emails into the register. A simple approval form can come later.

faqs.q: Can it check digital campaign proof?
faqs.a: It checks that screenshots, reports or links are attached and not reused. Checking campaign delivery against ad platform data can be added if partners share access.

faqs.q: Do partners need to change how they claim?
faqs.a: Not to start. Agreeing a standard claim format over time reduces exceptions.

faqs.q: Is this the same system as your distributor claims settlement?
faqs.a: Yes. It runs on the same claims engine as our live distributor claims settlement, configured to your fund rules during a pilot.
